Create a sparse decaying industrial district at amber dusk on flat pale-beige ground. Run a broad elevated roadway lengthwise on concrete piers, with a narrower rusted steel rail viaduct crossing diagonally beneath it. Cluster roughly twenty-five two- to four-story brick warehouses, workshops, and tenement-like blocks along both corridors, densest near the crossing and separated by broad empty lots toward the perimeter. Use weathered walls, repetitive dark windows, and rust-streaked roofs, with larger mills farther out. Add utility poles, sagging wires, chain-link fences, graffiti barriers, fire escapes, catwalks, pipes, and rooftop vents. Exclude people, vehicles, and vegetation, and frame distant edges with thin hazy skyline silhouettes.
